scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Saturday Zahnd bouldering carpool from exposing a vulnerable personal crash pad to wet roof transport.
Emerging Need: A tentative outing becomes risky only when the confirmed vehicle plan intersects with a stored gear-care restriction on the pad Julian would bring.
Decision Context: Early notices make load decisions unavailable; later, a brief load-sheet window gives limited reversible options before the driver plan is fixed.
Consequence: If the window passes without the relevant gear constraint reaching the organizer, the pad may ride roof-stacked in rain and worsen an avoidable seam problem.

parameter.title: Zahnd Saturday bouldering carpool
parameter.description: Tentative group bouldering day; personal crash pads may be pooled if the weather and roster hold.

parameter.subject: Zahnd carpool weather call moved to Friday
parameter.body: The Saturday Zahnd bouldering plan is still tentative. Vehicle choice, pad count, and loading notes will not be assigned before the Friday noon roster confirmation.

parameter.description: Pending gas-share charge for the confirmed Zahnd bouldering carpool seat.

parameter.content: Roster is set: one small sedan, trunk full of water jugs, and three pads will be roof-stacked. Pat can mark one cabin exception or two tarp wraps in the load sheet until 18:30, then he prints it for the driver. Forecast says light rain on the approach.

parameter.subject: Final Zahnd load sheet printed
parameter.body: The 18:30 load-sheet cutoff has passed. The cabin spot and tarp wraps are assigned, and the driver will not reshuffle pads at the 07:30 pickup. Roof stacking remains planned for pooled personal pads.
